data.case_title: Muster BKK: Increase in Monthly Health and Long-Term Care Insurance Contribution
data.title: Muster BKK: Increase in Monthly Health and Long-Term Care Insurance Contribution
data.summary: Muster BKK notifies Sam Rivera, insured as a student (§ 5 Abs. 1 Nr. 9 SGB V), that his monthly contribution to health and long-term care insurance (Beitragsbescheid) rises from €146.29 to €156.55 from 01.10.2026, because the BAföG-based assessment basis (Bedarf) increases from €855.00 to €915.00. The amount continues to be debited automatically on the 15th of each month, first at the new rate on 15.10.2026.
data.explanation: This letter is a routine yearly recalculation of your compulsory student health and care insurance contribution, linked to the official BAföG rate that just went up. You don't need to do anything: the higher amount will simply be debited automatically each month as before. If you think the calculation is wrong, you can file an objection (Widerspruch) with Muster BKK, but note that filing one does not stop you from having to keep paying the current amount in the meantime, and the period shown by the app must be respected. For most people this is a standard adjustment and no professional advice is needed, but you can ask a Sozialberatung if something looks incorrect.
